requiredFindings.location: PLAN-r2.md section 1.0 B2-b0 current oracle and project_v3; LD-B2B-5
requiredFindings.title: The DD replacement does not make every SLM observation obey SX-1
requiredFindings.finding: SLM finish(root) gathers nestedRepositories directly from all fs entries with vcs, without consulting DD.classify_path. Replacing its DD global therefore still reports repositories underneath .opensip. The stated project_v3 operation changes version/shape but specifies no observation filtering or boundary correction. A production walker that never enters the custody anchor cannot reproduce those fields byte for byte.

reproduction.input: With the bound B2-a DD installed as SLM.DD, use a synthetic explicit root /h/w, an observed directory /h/w/.opensip, and a directory /h/w/.opensip/hidden-repo with vcs=True; uid 1000, accountHome /h, all directory modes 0755, prunedTreeMarkerInventory not-enumerated.
reproduction.actual: SLM accepts and returns nestedRepositories=["/h/w/.opensip/hidden-repo"], alongside the correctly pruned .opensip row.
reproduction.expected: No nested-repository observation beneath the custody anchor, consistently with SX-1 and the planned no-descent walker.

requiredFindings.requiredChange: Specify a bounded current-reference observation adapter or explicit reviewed algorithm correction in B2-b0, rather than only a DD swap and V3 relabeling. It must prevent below-anchor boundary observations and align the oracle input population with the native walker, while preserving historical replay separately. Add a hidden-repository-under-.opensip control and analogous pruning/nested-boundary population controls; verify that no hidden path or excluded-unit observation is invented from subtrees the walker never enters. Preserve the complete boundary-inventory comparison and partial-provenance contract.
